title: Settings
description: The settings that belong to your account.
section-account-description: Who you are here, and what you have connected to it.
section-privacy-description: What your account publishes about itself.
log-out-description: Ends this session on this device. Nothing is deleted.
could-not-save: Could not save that. Try again in a moment.
hide-loadouts-description: Takes your builds off your own page and off the tables that name a player.
loadouts-still-counted: Your battles still count towards the figures every vehicle’s loadouts tab is built from, with nothing naming you. To stop sending them at all, untick sharing in the game mod, which also deletes what it has already sent.
hide-battles-description: Only you can see the Battles tab of your profile. Your battles keep being recorded, still count in the site’s statistics, and stay visible on the pages of the other players who were in them.
